name: Osoby prikaz: Po sledam teni
source:
After the sudden disappearance of Artyom Kalashnikov, the FSB leadership sends his partner, Lieutenant Nastya Nakhimova from the Retrospective Department, to the Sovyonok pioneer camp. Her task is to find clues, figure out where Artyom disappeared to, and carefully cover up the tracks he left behind.

Nastya has a month to complete the mission. During this time, she will have to:
- Infiltrate the camp: Find a way into the new shift of Sovyonok (only a couple of old acquaintances are left here) and build an ironclad alibi. She will have to interact closely with the pioneers, using their trust for her own purposes.
- Cover her tracks: Pull off a highly complex information cleanup. No physical eliminations: only social engineering, erasing the memories of witnesses (which will affect territory even outside the camp), and disposing of the equipment left by her partner.
- Put the puzzle together: Restore the chronology of events from three years ago by studying logs and talking to people to understand the fugitive's true motives. By her own personal decision, the operative will have to continue the search in Tokyo.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748331935]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阿尔乔姆·卡拉什尼科夫突然失踪后，俄罗斯联邦安全局领导层将他的搭档、回顾部门的纳斯蒂亚·纳希莫娃中尉派往索维诺克先锋营。她的任务是寻找线索，找出Artyom消失的地方，并小心地掩盖他留下的痕迹。

娜斯蒂亚有一个月的时间来完成任务。在此期间，她必须：
- 潜入营地：找到进入索维诺克新转变的方法（这里只剩下几个老熟人）并建立铁证如山的不在场证据。她必须与先驱者密切互动，利用他们的信任来实现自己的目的。
- 掩盖她的踪迹：完成高度复杂的信息清理工作。没有物理消除：只有社会工程，删除目击者的记忆（这甚至会影响营地外的领土），并处理她的伴侣留下的设备。
- 拼凑谜题：通过研究日志和与人们交谈来了解逃亡者的真实动机，恢复三年前事件的年表。根据她个人的决定，特工必须在东京继续搜寻。
